FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 283
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/08/2025
Senate Bill 283 as introduced would allow the State Treasurer to invest certain state funds in
digital assets under certain conditions.
This bill would increase the obligations of the State Treasurer to implement the provisions of
this bill.
